从真值表出发，把一句话接成一块电路，再用搭出的门搭更大的句子。: Start from truth tables: wire a sentence as a circuit, then build bigger sentences from the gates you made.
a ∨ b：至少一个输入是真，就输出真。: a ∨ b: outputs true when at least one input is true.
一句话在每一种情况下是真是假，能交给电路去算吗？: Can a circuit work out whether a sentence is true in every case?
接一次、在真值表的每一行上运行的电路：输出这句话在那一行的真值。: A circuit wired once and run on every row of a truth table: it outputs the sentence’s value on that row.
<part-ref to=\"part:gAnd\"></part-ref>：两: <part-ref to="part:gAnd"></part-ref> outputs true only when both inputs are true.
接一块电路，算出「下雨，并且不刮风」在每一行的真值。: Wire a board that works out the value of “it rains and it is not windy” on every row.
两件事要同时成立。: Two things must hold at once.
<wiki-ref to=\"circuit\"></wiki-ref>只接一次: A <wiki-ref to="circuit"></wiki-ref> is wired once, and the machine runs it on every row. <part-ref to="part:gNot"></part-ref> stands for negation, ¬.
接一块电路，算出「不是『不下雨』」在每一行的真值。: Wire a board that works out the value of “it is not the case that it is not raining” on every row.
「不下雨」怎样接？再否定一次呢？: How is “it is not raining” wired? And negated once more?
「或」写作 ∨：至少一边为真，它就为真。证明器里还没有这个门。: “Or” is written ∨: true when at least one side is. The prover has no gate for it yet.
只用与门和非门，算出「下雨，或者刮风」在每一行的真值。: Using only And and Not, work out the value of “it rains or it is windy” on every row.
先看它什么时候为假：四行里只有一行。: Look first at when it is false: only one row of the four.
搭出的<part-ref to=\"lemma:gOr\"></part-ref: The <part-ref to="lemma:gOr"></part-ref> gate you built is a part now.
算出「下雨或者刮风，并且很冷」在每一行的真值。: Work out the value of “it rains or it is windy, and it is cold” on every row.
¬a：输入是真，输出假；输入是假，输出真。: ¬a: true in gives false out; false in gives true out.
a ∧ b：两个输入都是真，才输出真；否则输出假。: a ∧ b: outputs true only when both inputs are true; otherwise false.
在元件上为任意对象取名 a，在框内证明 P(a) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 ∀x: Name an arbitrary object a on the part. Prove P(a) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain ∀x. P(x) outside. a must not occur in any open assumption.
在元件上选定一样东西 t，得到 t = t。: Choose a thing t on the part; gives t = t.
带一个框，A 在元件上设定。框内可以使用假设 A；框内证出 B 并接到「结论」，: A box, with A set on the part. Inside, A may be used as an assumption; prove B there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives A → B.
带两个框，证元件上选定的 ∀x. P(x)。第一个框证 P(0)；第二个框内的数: Two boxes, proving the ∀x. P(x) chosen on the part. The first proves P(0); in the second the number is called a (named on the part; it must not occur in any open assumption), P(a) may be used as an assumption, and P(S a) is to be proved. Once both are proved, the part gives ∀x. P(x).
接入 A ∧ B，两个输出口分别得到 A 和 B。: Connect A ∧ B to get A and B at separate outputs.
接入 A ∨ B，在两个框中分别假设 A、B。两个框都证出同一句 C 并接到各自: Connect A ∨ B and assume A and B in separate boxes. When both prove the same C and connect it to their respective “Conclusion” ports, the part outputs C.
接入 A 和 B，得到 A ∧ B。: Connect A and B to get A ∧ B.
接入 A，选定另一句 B 和它的位置，得到 A ∨ B 或 B ∨ A；不需要证: Connect A and choose another statement B and its position to get A ∨ B or B ∨ A. B need not be proved.
接入 P(t)，以 t 为例得到 ∃x. P(x)。只有一个相符的存在命题时自动: Connect P(t) to obtain ∃x. P(x), with t as a witness. If exactly one existential statement fits, it is selected automatically; if several fit, choose the conclusion on the part.
接入 s = t 和一句含 s 的话；元件标出这句话里的每一处 s，勾选的几处换: Wire in s = t and a sentence containing s; the part marks each s in it, and the ticked ones become t.
接入 ∀x. P(x)，选定对象 t，得到 P(t)。: Connect ∀x. P(x) and choose an object t to obtain P(t).
接入 ∃x. P(x)，在元件上为存在的对象取名 a。框内可以假设 P(a)；证: Connect ∃x. P(x) and name the existing object a on the part. Inside the box, P(a) may be assumed. Prove C and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain C outside. a must not appear in C or in any open assumption.
由 A → B 和 A 得到 B。: From A → B and A, gives B.
由矛盾 ⊥ 得到元件上选定的任意一句。: From the contradiction ⊥, gives whatever sentence is chosen on the part.
